content: Emerging models in the delivery of diabetes self-management education and support (DSMES) include the use of telehealth, virtual environments, and mobile health applications. These approaches enhance accessibility and allow individuals to actively participate in self-management from the comfort of their homes. Virtual environments, which may incorporate avatars representing patients in interactive and gamified settings, have demonstrated significant potential in fostering patient engagement and motivation. Research has shown that virtual DSMES platforms can effectively aid in managing weight, blood pressure, and cholesterol levels, ultimately leading to improved diabetes-related health outcomes. These innovative delivery models highlight the critical importance of tailoring DSMES to meet the specific and diverse needs of different patient populations.
